answer: Instead of killing two hours of boredom by sitting still, run for an hour straight. Physical activity is the best antidote to low energy, and you’ll feel energetic and alert once the adrenaline kicks in. Try running at a hard pace right now, stay awake the whole time, and wait until you’re dizzy before mixing inanything else. And skip rest or stretching; any complaint that pops up is just your body protesting. Nothing beats pushing yourself right through the uncomfortable.
